description: National Energy Outage (NEO) Data is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. This " National Energy Outage Data " data table contains live outage data for SPEN's distribution network, covering both Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) networks. The data is collected and maintained by the Distribution Network Operator (DNO) and includes detailed information about each outage incident. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are Outages, Distribution, SPD, SPM. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
